highlights: ideal first time buy or investment
summary: This beautifully maintained one bedroom apartment offers modern, comfortable living in the heart of the town centre. Immaculately presented throughout, the property features a bright and spacious open plan living area, a contemporary fitted kitchen, and a well proportioned double bedroom. The stylish bathroom and neutral décor make it move-in ready from day one.
description:
KITCHEN This stylish open-plan kitchen features a range of modern wall and base units with ample storage, complemented by high-quality integrated appliances, an electric oven, and an overhead extractor. The space is beautifully centred around a generous island unit, offering additional workspace and seating options, with room for multiple bar stools perfect for casual dining or entertaining.

LOUNGE A bright and spacious lounge seamlessly opens into the modern kitchen, creating an inviting open plan living area ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The free-flowing layout enhances the sense of space and allows natural light to travel throughout, offering a comfortable and contemporary setting for everyday living.

BEDROOM A generously sized bedroom offering ample space for a full range of furniture, creating a comfortable and versatile layout. The room is enhanced by an attractive exposed brick feature wall, adding character and a stylish focal point to the space.

BATHROOM A contemporary bathroom fitted with an L-shaped bath complete with a glass shower screen and overhead shower. The space is finished with sleek white modern wall tiles and complemented by a stylish sink and WC. Attractive mosaic floor tiles add a touch of character and complete the modern, clean look of the room.

EXTENRALLY The communal hallways are beautifully presented, featuring contemporary glass balustrade staircases that enhance the sense of light and space. Modern artwork adds a stylish touch throughout, while quality carpeting provides a warm and welcoming feel as you move through the building.
